newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch round up suspected paedophile ring.
newsitem.headline: Dutch round up suspected paedophile ring.

text.p: Seven Dutch men have been arrested on suspicion of child sexual abuse and the manufacture of child pornography, police in the eastern border town of Hengelo said on Tuesday.
Five boys aged 13-26 had so far filed complaints with the police which related to incidents spanning 12 years up until last month, police spokesman Harry Holslag said.
"At the time the crimes were committed all the victims were younger than 16," he said.
A police raid on the home of the 51 year-old ringleader uncovered filming equipment and 350 homosexual pornographic video tapes, including about a dozen featuring child pornography, he said.

The boys allege the man enticed them to his home to play video games and pinball. After winning the boys' confidence he and the six other accused abused them sexually and filmed their exploits, Holslag said.
He said three of the men, all of whom were arrested in January, were still in custody.
